title: "MeBo Leaves a Piece of You Behind": Designing a Relational Voice-Based Memory Companion for Older Adults
abstract: arXiv:2609.24706v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autobiographical remembering supports identity, well-being, and social connection in later life, yet voice-based memory technologies largely rely on isolated prompts. We designed and built MeBo, a fully functional relational voice-based memory companion, through participatory design with 11 older adults. Their accounts shaped four Design Strategies that guided MeBo's interaction design and multi-agent implementation. In a mixed-methods evaluation with 20 older adults, participants found MeBo exceptionally usable (SUS = 87.75), enjoyable, sociable, emotionally responsive, and trustworthy. Participants reported higher positive affect and momentary social connection and lower negative affect after the session than before. Participants described how MeBo followed their stories, returned to earlier memories, adapted to their preferences, and made its growing memory visible and controllable. translated_title: “MeBo 留下了你的一部分”：为老年人设计一种关系型语音记忆伴侣
translated_abstract: 自传式回忆有助于支持晚年生活中的身份认同、幸福感和社交联系，然而现有的基于语音的记忆技术大多依赖于孤立的提示。我们通过与11位老年人开展参与式设计，设计并构建了MeBo——一个功能完整的关系型语音记忆伴侣。他们的叙述形成了四项设计策略，指导了MeBo的交互设计和多智能体实现。在一项针对20位老年人的混合方法评估中，参与者认为MeBo具有极佳的可用性（SUS = 87.75），令人愉悦、善于社交、情感响应灵敏且值得信赖。参与者在会话结束后报告了比会话前更高的积极情绪和即时社交连接感，以及更低的消极情绪。参与者描述了MeBo如何跟随他们的故事、回溯更早的记忆、适应他们的偏好，并使其不断增长的记忆变得可见且可控。MeBo的关系型框架揭示了围绕……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 通过与11位老年人参与式设计，研究团队开发了关系型语音记忆伴侣MeBo，它能持续跟随用户故事、回溯早期记忆并适应个人偏好，在20位老年人的评估中实现了极佳可用性（SUS=87.75），并显著提升了积极情绪与社交连接感。
